provenance.source: Figure 4(a-c), visually checked against each original PNG and cross-checked with extracted PDF page 12 text
provenance.note: Original figures show a lower triangle. Off-diagonal values are mirrored only to store a symmetric matrix; the diagonal and mirrored values are not counted as independent comparisons. Published coefficients are never replaced by recalculated values.

overall.reason: The paper does not sufficiently define how the dimensions are combined into an overall input vector. Its prose assigns -0.11 to Linux/Android, while the figure places -0.11 at HarmonyOS/Android. No aggregation rule is invented, so Overall is excluded from the nine core comparisons.

excluded.severity: Excluded by the paper because severity labeling schemes vary across systems.
excluded.code_level: Not among the three RQ3 dimensions examined in Figure 4(a-c).
